name: Jaya Ballard
description: Jaya Ballard is a legendary pyromancer and one of the oldest planeswalkers, born on Dominaria and later a mentor to Chandra Nalaar.

summary.text: Jaya Ballard is a legendary pyromancer and one of the oldest planeswalkers, born on Dominaria and later a mentor to Chandra Nalaar.

bio.text: Born on Dominaria over 1,500 years ago, she played an important part in its early history before disappearing for centuries.
She resurfaced as an older, wiser mentor to fledgling pyromancers, including Chandra Nalaar.
At Keral Keep she had been posing as Mother Luti, having gone back to Regatha to find a religion built on her and to guide it.

She at first refused Chandra's request for a secret to greater power, but later invited her aboard and trained her, and fought alongside Karn and the others against Bolas without taking the Gatewatch oath.
She joined the fight against the Eternals on Ravnica and helped Chandra burn the remaining Dreadhorde.
Alongside her old friend Jodah, she sought to keep the Keldon-Benalish peace talks going and then fought the Phyrexians, her fire sterilizing their creatures.
Compleated Ajani drove his axe into her and hurled her off the Mana Rig, and she died.

status.text: She is dead, killed by compleated Ajani, and is later remembered by Chandra, Jodah and Ajani himself.

timeline.summary: Serenok tells Chandra she is ready and that she is Jaya.
timeline.quote: You're ready. You're her .

timeline.summary: Chandra confronts Jaya, who has revealed she was posing as Mother Luti, and Jaya explains she went back to Regatha to find a religion built on her and guided it.
timeline.quote: Two hundred years later, I went back and found they'd started a religion based on me.

timeline.summary: Chandra offers Jaya her goggles and asks for the secret to being a more powerful pyromancer, and Jaya flatly refuses.
timeline.quote: Jaya took the goggles, and her expression turned hard as stone. "Absolutely not."

timeline.summary: Chandra tries again to change Jaya's mind, and Jaya says there is no secret and that Chandra does not know what she wants.
timeline.quote: There's no secret. To master your power, you need to know what you want, know your true self.

timeline.summary: Animate trees swarm the crater to reach the Sylex, and Chandra and Jaya fight them off with fire.
timeline.quote: They were desperate to get to Karn and the Sylex.

timeline.summary: Multani rises as a giant of roots and branches, and Karn says he is still semiconscious.
timeline.quote: He's still semiconscious. He would never hurt us if he were himself.

timeline.summary: Chandra apologizes to Jaya for how she treated her, and Jaya says Chandra has potential and invites her aboard.
timeline.quote: what you did with Multani shows me you have potential.

timeline.summary: Gideon, Liliana, Jaya and Chandra discuss killing Belzenlok without the Chain Veil, and Liliana raises using the Blackblade.
timeline.quote: It's a sword that slew an elder dragon, and Gideon is too delicate to allow us to use it.

timeline.summary: Jhoira offers to take Jaya to the Academy in Tolaria West, and Jaya says she is not sure how back she is yet.
timeline.quote: I'm not sure just how back I am yet, if you know what I mean.

timeline.summary: Chandra practices concentration with thirty-seven fireballs while Jaya says what the Multani episode showed her.
timeline.quote: It was the first indication I'd ever seen that you were capable of concentrating on something for any length of time.

timeline.summary: Chandra admits Nissa's departure made her feel abandoned and says she is now ready to burn Belzenlok and the Cabal off the plane.
timeline.quote: I'm ready to burn Belzenlok and the Cabal right off this plane.

timeline.summary: Urborg's ash cloud comes into view on the horizon as the Weatherlight approaches.
timeline.quote: They were coming up on Urborg.

timeline.summary: Yargle grips the Weatherlight's bow and tosses the ship about while the crew fights it and Liliana struggles to hold her undead army.
timeline.quote: The purple bolts slid across Yargle's slimy skin with no effect.

timeline.summary: Urgoros lands on the deck and fights the crew, and Liliana cannot control it or use the Chain Veil.
timeline.quote: Jhoira, I can't stop it!

timeline.summary: Tiana deflects Urgoros's spear to save Liliana, and Jaya, Karn, Tiana and Arvad drive it off the ship.
timeline.quote: Tiana suddenly landed in front of her.

timeline.summary: Gideon gives Teferi the Gatewatch oath, while Karn and Jaya agree to fight Bolas without taking the oath.
timeline.quote: Gideon was giving Teferi the Gatewatch oath while Chandra stood by.

timeline.summary: The planeswalkers leave Dominaria, but Liliana cannot planeswalk and Nicol Bolas appears to claim her.
timeline.quote: Nicol Bolas materialized out of the darkness, his huge scaled dragon form looming over her

timeline.summary: On the new plane Jace tells the others that Liliana never intended to come and used them, but Gideon insists she has changed.
timeline.quote: She used you, just like she uses everyone.

timeline.summary: Jace, Lavinia, Gideon, Teferi, Chandra, Jaya, Ajani and Karn arrive and join the fight, and Gideon names the enemy the Eternals.
timeline.quote: Form up! The Eternals are still coming! We need to save as many people as possible!

timeline.summary: Gideon Jura tells the planeswalkers to split up through the city to save people and rally others, and Kaya recruits Rat and Teyo.
timeline.quote: We need to split up. Spread out through the city.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Jaya burn the remaining Dreadhorde to ashes with dignity at Samut's request.
timeline.quote: meticulously burned every last one—every last fragment—down to ashes

timeline.summary: Karn and Ajani warn Jodah, Jaya and the summit leaders that the Phyrexians have returned, but are met with doubt.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians have returned to Dominaria.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Jaya refuse to halt negotiations without a location for the Phyrexians but promise to help afterward.
timeline.quote: "We will go with you, Karn," said Jaya.

timeline.summary: Radha and Aron are about to sign the peace when Teferi arrives with news that the Phyrexians were on Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: "It's the Phyrexians—they were on Kamigawa."

timeline.summary: The news of the Phyrexian threat unsettles the summit, and the signing of the peace is left uncertain.
timeline.quote: Radha and Aron had not signed—and this made it seem like they wouldn't.

timeline.summary: Karn seizes a thrush that is a Phyrexian spy, which attacks him with corrosive cables, and the group traps it in a cage.
timeline.quote: Karn seized the bird. "I know what you are."

timeline.summary: Radha and the Keldons withdraw and lock the Phyrexians into the room with the planeswalkers, who fight them.
timeline.quote: The brass double doors slammed shut

timeline.summary: Jodah opens a portal to New Argive's watchtower; Karn, Teferi, Stenn and Jodah escape while Jaya burns the room.
timeline.quote: Jaya grinned in triumph as she raised her hands in a blaze of fire and set the whole room alight.

timeline.summary: A Phyrexian creature follows through the portal; Stenn locks down the watchtower and gives Karn the key, as they realize they cannot trust anyone.
timeline.quote: Stenn handed Karn the key.

timeline.summary: Locked in the watchtower, Karn refuses to reveal the sylex's location or his plan until the group captures the Phyrexian spy and is sure of its members.
timeline.quote: "I have a plan to find and defeat Sheoldred," Karn said.

timeline.summary: The group splits up to search the tower, Karn and Teferi taking the lower floors and Stenn the basement.
timeline.quote: "Jaya and I can take the upper floors," Jodah said.

timeline.summary: Karn and Teferi find signs of the creature in the storage room and overhear Jodah and Jaya arguing through a vent.
timeline.quote: A throbbing chunk of meat had attached itself, barnacle-like, to the copper.

timeline.summary: Jodah and Jaya fight the squid-like Phyrexian, which splits into pieces and escapes through the stone.
timeline.quote: The creature split again, this time into four small chittering beasts

timeline.summary: Jaya saves Jodah and Karn with a blast of fire, which seems to sterilize the creatures.
timeline.quote: Flame roared throughout the room.

timeline.summary: Karn tells Jaya the sylex is hidden in Suq'Ata.
timeline.quote: "Yes," Karn said. "It is hidden in Suq'Ata."

timeline.summary: Karn and Jaya find Teferi pinned and gutted by a Phyrexian monstrosity; Karn kills it and Jaya burns dozens more.
timeline.quote: They found Teferi pinned to floor by a Phyrexian monstrosity

timeline.summary: Stenn's cables ensnare Jaya, and Karn dismembers him as Jaya burns him; the tower's lockdown is lifted.
timeline.quote: He dismembered Stenn—no, not Stenn, the Phyrexian who had killed Stenn

timeline.summary: Karn calls the Weatherlight with the amulet and Shanna promises to come, while the group braces for the Phyrexians closing in.
timeline.quote: "You're in luck—we're not far.

timeline.summary: On the Weatherlight, Karn proposes forcing the Phyrexians into open war by baiting them with the sylex, the Mana Rig and himself; the group splits up to recruit allies.
timeline.quote: "We must force the Phyrexians into open warfare," Karn said

timeline.summary: Jaya meets Ajani and Danitha Capashen, who is searching for her kidnapped father, and joins them to attack the Phyrexian cave.
timeline.quote: "Well, one sure way to get someone out of a cave is smoke."

timeline.summary: Jaya, Ajani and Danitha's forces attack the cave, burning the guards, but are overwhelmed when more Phyrexians pour out.
timeline.quote: The Benalish were being overwhelmed.

timeline.summary: Ertai emerges from the cave with Aron Capashen, now compleated.
timeline.quote: And Aron Capashen stepped from the cave's mouth.

timeline.summary: Ertai summons a Phyrexian dreadnought from the mountain.
timeline.quote: A Phyrexian monstrosity broke free from the mountain in front of them

timeline.summary: Ertai threatens to have the dreadnought kill everyone unless Jaya and Ajani surrender, and Danitha stops the fight.
timeline.quote: "If you don't give yourselves up to me," Ertai said

timeline.summary: Ertai threatens that Sheoldred will hear of this, and the dreadnought collapses.
timeline.quote: Ertai bellowed, "Sheoldred will hear of this!"

timeline.summary: Jaya, Danitha, Radha and the Keldon and Benalish warriors pour from the Argosy; Jaya burns Phyrexians with fire and lightning.
timeline.quote: Keldon warriors and Benalish knights poured from the Argosy onto the Mana Rig's decks.

timeline.summary: Compleated Ajani drives his axe into Jaya, and wounds Karn with it.
timeline.quote: He swept up his axe and drove into her body.

timeline.summary: Jaya burns Ajani's fur away to reveal wires, and he hurls her off the Mana Rig; she dies.
timeline.quote: With a thrust of his ruined hand, he hurled Jaya over the edge of the Mana Rig.

timeline.summary: Teferi, Jodah and Jhoira build a monument to Jaya in Shiv's desert; Teferi leaves an empty pyramid for Karn.
timeline.quote: Jodah, Teferi, and Jhoira had remained to build this: a monument for Jaya.

timeline.summary: Chandra and Jodah, drinking in the hall, toast and reminisce about the dead Jaya.
timeline.quote: Let me have one turn on Saheeli's time machine, and I'd go back

timeline.summary: Jodah leads Elspeth in casting Jaya's spell, and she channels her hope of saving Ajani, producing a blaze that destroys the behemoth.
timeline.quote: A column of radiance poured out of her

timeline.summary: Chandra coaches Wrenn on controlling her inner fire and recalls Jaya's teachings and Ajani's killing of Jaya.
timeline.quote: Jaya's dead, Ajani killed her

timeline.summary: Nahiri accuses Ajani of slaughtering Theros's gods and murdering Jaya Ballard; he snarls in grief.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: You slaughtered the gods of Theros. You murdered Jaya Ballard.

timeline.summary: Ajani recalls attacking Jaya on the Mana Rig and answers Nur that his isolation might be punishment.
timeline.quote: Ajani would never forget Jaya's face as she plummeted from the Mana Rig

timeline.summary: Jaya, born on Dominaria over 1,500 years ago, plays an important part in its early history before disappearing for centuries.
timeline.quote: Born on Dominaria more than 1,500 years ago, she was a hot-headed, sarcastic hero

timeline.summary: Jaya resurfaces as an older, wiser mentor to fledgling pyromancers, including Chandra Nalaar.
timeline.quote: she resurfaced as an older, wiser mentor to fledgling pyromancers

relations.note: Jaya is training Chandra to master her pyromancy
relations.quote: If you know what you really want, you don't make mistakes.

relations.note: Ertai demands Jaya and Ajani surrender and threatens to kill them all.
relations.quote: "Jaya. Ajani. If you don't give yourselves up to me,"

relations.note: Ajani stabbed Jaya and hurled her off the Mana Rig.
relations.quote: With a thrust of his ruined hand, he hurled Jaya over the edge of the Mana Rig.

relations.note: he raised his axe against her
relations.quote: until he raised his axe against her.
